decisions.reason: As a core safety shoe line with several models and no sign of a shortfall, organizational slack supports keeping it while results build.
Comfort insole has only a passing mention and overlaps with the flagship moulded insole, and after two years its below-aspiration results trigger problemistic search and rationalization.
Its own page signals strategic priority and likely above-aspiration performance, making discontinuation unlikely.
Firefighting and rescue boots fit the firm's protective niche with no evidence of a shortfall, so slack supports continuing them.
As the home-page flagship and stated direction of the firm, it remains highly unlikely to be dropped.
